entities.name: USER DEVELOPER
entities.rationale: User developer pushing code changes to Git on the left side.

entities.name: GIT
entities.rationale: Git source control repository receiving commits from User Developer.

entities.name: EKS (LAGOON)
entities.rationale: Amazon EKS cluster icon on left section with Lagoon text annotation on top.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Amazon EKS cluster on the right section pointing down to EC2 and EC2 Spot.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: EC2 compute instance connected between right EKS and Aurora RAG.

entities.name: AURORA RAG
entities.rationale: Amazon Aurora database annotated with RAG receiving connection from EC2.

entities.name: EC2 SPOT
entities.rationale: EC2 Spot instance component receiving connection from right EKS and pointing to EBS GP3 and EFS.

entities.name: EBS GP3
entities.rationale: Amazon EBS GP3 block storage volume connected from EC2 Spot.

entities.name: EFS
entities.rationale: Amazon EFS elastic file system storage connected from EC2 Spot.

visual_connections.description: User Developer pushes code commits to Git.
Git repository triggers deployment to EKS (Lagoon).
Arrow from EKS (Lagoon) points across vertical divider line towards right-side EKS.
Right-side EKS cluster points down to EC2.
EC2 instance connects to Aurora RAG database.
Right-side EKS cluster points down-right to EC2 Spot.
EC2 Spot instance connects directly to EBS GP3 volume.
EC2 Spot instance connects directly to EFS file system.
